# Real Section

A footnote definition absorbs the line below it as its own body.

[^1]: a footnote body
# Not A Heading — Footnote

A link-reference definition renders to nothing, so the heading below it is real.

[x]: http://example.com
# Below A Link Reference

An empty bracket pair is a link reference too, not a footnote.

[]: http://example.com
# Below An Empty Label

A caret that is not a valid footnote label is a link reference.

[^ 1]: http://example.com
# Below A Caret With A Space

A `<pre>` block is CommonMark condition 1, and Session 183's gate deleted this one.

<pre>
code
</pre>
# Below A Pre Block

A real HTML block is not narrowed away either.

<div>
inner
</div>
# Below A Div

A tag outside CommonMark's condition-6 list still opens a raw HTML block.

<meta charset="utf-8">
# Below A Meta Tag

A braced TeX macro is a raw block, not an inline.

\vspace{1em}
# Below A Braced Macro

A bare macro alone on its line is a raw TeX block.

\clearpage
# Below A Bare Macro

An empty bullet marker really is block-level, whatever it looks like.
